purpose: Read-only verification of same-generation PC sibling grouping, not assertion of applicability to an H model
ownWordsFindings: The four PC models share one supplementary manual covering differences from wheeled models.
The cover instructs readers to consult the main manual for other explanations.
No H model is specified on the cover as the corresponding wheeled model. This does not establish interchangeability with KL41H or KL50H.
storageNote: PDF remains scratch-only for reading; publication uses official notice links, with no PDF bytes copied to the repository.
